ARCHIVE = ROOT/'docs/benchmarks/data/fp4-accel-result-v1-endpoints.json.gz'


def environment(variant, profile=False):
    require(variant in VARIANTS, 'unknown delivery configuration')
    env = dict(os.environ)
    for name in ('GPUP_DELIVERY2_CONTROL', 'GPUP_CHECKER_ORIGINAL','GPUP_DELIVERY3_VARIANT','GPUP_DELIVERY3_PROFILE'):
        env.pop(name, None)
    env['GPUP_DELIVERY4_VARIANT'] = variant
    env['GPUP_DELIVERY4_PROFILE'] = '1' if profile else '0'
    return env


def numerical_source():
    old = ROOT/'research/lp-delivery3/src/main.rs'
    new = ROOT/'research/lp-delivery4/src/main.rs'
    def body(path):
        text = path.read_text()
        return text[text.index('    fn lane('):text.index('fn main()')]
    require(body(old) == body(new), 'numerical state machine differs')
    original_model=(ROOT/'research/lp-fp4-accel/src/model.rs').read_text()
    require((ROOT/'research/lp-delivery4/src/model.rs').read_text().replace('use crate::identity::hex;\n','')==original_model.replace('use optimizer_experiment::sha256::hex;\n',''),'model arithmetic changed')
    return dict(parent=ref(old), candidate=ref(new), unchanged='lane, preparation, solve, command state machine')


def process_cases(model, endpoint):
    rows = []
    request = dict(endpoint=endpoint, tier='certified-1e-9')
    for variant in VARIANTS:
        for profile in (False, True):
            env = {**environment(variant, profile), 'CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES':''}
            requests = []
            for status in ('completed', 'cancelled', 'limit', 'error', 'refused'):
                value = copy.deepcopy(request); value['endpoint']['transport'] = status; requests.append(value)
            result = subprocess.run([str(BINARY), 'check-service', str(model)], input=b''.join(json.dumps(v).encode()+b'\n' for v in requests), capture_output=True, timeout=15, env=env)
            values = [json.loads(line) for line in result.stdout.splitlines()]
            require(result.returncode == 0 and len(values) == 6, 'fresh checker lifecycle')
            require(values[1]['accepted'] and all(not r['accepted'] for r in values[2:]), 'terminal status authority')
            require(bool(result.stderr) == profile, 'diagnostic instrumentation mode')
            if profile:
                events = [json.loads(line) for line in result.stderr.splitlines()]
                require(len(events) == 7 and 'delivery4_checker_setup' in events[0] and 'delivery4_process' in events[-1], 'diagnostic schema')
                for event in events[1:-1]:
                    p = event['delivery4_checker_assessment']
                    require(0 <= p['decode_ns'] <= p['assessed_ns'] <= p['sent_ns'], 'child timing order')
            rows.append(dict(variant=variant, profile=profile, case='fresh-status-EOF', passed=True))
            malformed = {}
            for key, value in [('model_sha256','wrong'), ('primal',[]), ('dual',[]), ('transport','optimal')]:
                bad = copy.deepcopy(request); bad['endpoint'][key] = value; malformed[key] = json.dumps(bad).encode()+b'\n'
            bad = copy.deepcopy(request); bad['tier'] = 'certified-1e-6'; malformed['tier'] = json.dumps(bad).encode()+b'\n'
            malformed.update(duplicate=b'{"tier":"a","tier":"b","endpoint":null}\n', truncated=json.dumps(request).encode(), oversize=b' '*(8<<20)+b'\n')
            for case, payload in malformed.items():
                r = subprocess.run([str(BINARY),'check-service',str(model)],input=payload,capture_output=True,timeout=15,env=env)
                require(r.returncode != 0 and len(r.stdout.splitlines()) == 1, 'bad request accepted: '+case)
                rows.append(dict(variant=variant,profile=profile,case=case,passed=True))
    for changes in ({'GPUP_DELIVERY4_VARIANT':'auto'}, {'GPUP_DELIVERY4_PROFILE':'yes'}, {'GPUP_DELIVERY2_CONTROL':'1'}, {'GPUP_CHECKER_ORIGINAL':'1'},{'GPUP_DELIVERY3_VARIANT':'overlap'}):
        env = {**environment('control'), **changes, 'CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES':''}
        r = subprocess.run([str(BINARY),'check-service',str(model)],capture_output=True,timeout=10,env=env)
        require(r.returncode != 0 and not r.stdout, 'configuration fail-open')
        rows.append(dict(case='configuration-refusal',changes=changes,passed=True))
    r = subprocess.run([str(BINARY),'check-service',str(model)+'.missing'],capture_output=True,timeout=10,env={**environment('candidate'),'CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES':''})
    require(r.returncode != 0 and not r.stdout,'missing model became ready')
    rows.append(dict(case='missing-model',passed=True))
    return rows


def run(directory, count=3):
    out = Path(directory); out.mkdir(exist_ok=False, parents=True)
    archive = json.loads(gzip.decompress(ARCHIVE.read_bytes()))
    put(out/'manifest.json', dict(binary=ref(BINARY), archive=ref(ARCHIVE), count=count, variants=VARIANTS, source=numerical_source()))
    models=[]
    prior=ROOT/'research/lp-delivery3/target/release/lp-delivery3'
    for family,binding in archive['manifest']['models'].items():
        model=ROOT/binding['path'];require(ref(model)==binding,'original model changed')
        old_env=dict(os.environ)
        for k in ('GPUP_DELIVERY4_VARIANT','GPUP_DELIVERY4_PROFILE','GPUP_DELIVERY2_CONTROL','GPUP_CHECKER_ORIGINAL'):old_env.pop(k,None)
        old_env.update(GPUP_DELIVERY3_VARIANT='overlap',GPUP_DELIVERY3_PROFILE='0',CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES='')
        for unscaled in (False,True):
            args=['inspect',str(model)]+(['unscaled'] if unscaled else [])
            expected=json.loads(subprocess.check_output([str(prior),*args],env=old_env,timeout=30))
            for variant in VARIANTS:
                observed=json.loads(subprocess.check_output([str(BINARY),*args],env={**environment(variant),'CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES':''},timeout=30))
                require(bits(expected)==bits(observed),'original model representation changed')
                models.append(dict(family=family,unscaled=unscaled,variant=variant,exact=True))
    put(out/'representations.json',dict(prior=ref(prior),rows=models))
    rows = []
    for index,(key,value) in enumerate(archive['endpoints'].items()):
        endpoint = out/(key+'.endpoint.json'); put(endpoint,value['endpoint'])
        model = ROOT/archive['manifest']['models'][value['family']]['path']
        require(ref(model) == archive['manifest']['models'][value['family']], 'changed original model')
        expected = {k:v for k,v in value['certificate'].items() if k != 'checker_binary_sha256'}
        for variant in (VARIANTS if index%2 == 0 else VARIANTS[::-1]):
            dest = out/(key+'-'+variant+'.json')
            subprocess.run([str(BINARY),'transport-profile',str(model),str(endpoint),value['tier'],str(count),str(dest)],check=True,capture_output=True,timeout=30,env={**environment(variant),'CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES':''})
            result = load(dest)
            for row in result['rows']:
                require(bits({k:v for k,v in row['certificate'].items() if k != 'checker_binary_sha256'}) == bits(expected), 'serial receipt mismatch')
                require(row['certificate']['checker_binary_sha256'] == ref(BINARY)['sha256'], 'checker executable binding')
            rows.append(dict(key=key,family=value['family'],tier=value['tier'],variant=variant,accepted=expected['accepted'],median_ns=statistics.median(r['ns'] for r in result['rows']),setup_ns=result['setup_ns'],profile=ref(dest)))
        if (index+1)%20 == 0: print(dict(endpoints=index+1),flush=True)
    value = next(v for v in archive['endpoints'].values() if v['family']=='coupled-equality' and v['certificate']['accepted'])
    cases = process_cases(ROOT/archive['manifest']['models'][value['family']]['path'],value['endpoint'])
    put(out/'result.json', dict(status='passed',endpoints=len(archive['endpoints']),fresh_assessments=len(rows)*count,representations=ref(out/'representations.json'),rows=rows,process_cases=cases))
    print(dict(endpoints=len(archive['endpoints']),fresh_assessments=len(rows)*count,process_cases=len(cases)),flush=True)

if __name__ == '__main__':
    p=argparse.ArgumentParser(); p.add_argument('directory'); p.add_argument('--count',type=int,default=3); a=p.parse_args(); run(a.directory,a.count)

def bound(binding):

def replay():
    result=load(ROOT/'docs/benchmarks/data/delivery4-result-v1.json')
    portable=bound(result['cohorts_archive']);groups=portable['cohorts']
    for family,raw in portable['model_bytes'].items():
        require(hashlib.sha256(raw.encode()).hexdigest()==groups['confirmation']['manifest']['models'][family]['sha256'],'original model bytes changed')
    collected={k:[] for k in groups};logs={}
    for binding in result['archives']:
        archive=bound(binding);kind=archive['kind'];rows=archive['result']['rows'];manifest=groups[kind]['manifest']
        for row in rows:
            original=portable['originals'][row['original_result']['path']]
            for record in row['records']:
                value=archive['outputs'][record['result']['path']]
                matches(value,original,manifest['binary'])
                require(record['certified']==(row['family']!='infinite-bound-refusal'),'coverage changed')
                require(record['solve_ns']==value['solve_ns'] and record['costs_ns']==value['costs_ns'],'timer binding differs')
            if kind=='profile':logs[row['id']]=archive['stderr'][row['id']]
        collected[kind]+=rows
    for kind,rows in collected.items():
        require(bits(rows)==bits(groups[kind]['result']['rows']),'archive/cohort rows differ')
        manifest=groups[kind]['manifest'];require(len(rows)==len(manifest['cells']),'incomplete cohort')
        require({r['id'] for r in rows}=={c['id'] for c in manifest['cells']},'identity mismatch')
    decisions=summarize(collected['confirmation'],list(groups['confirmation']['manifest']['models']))

    from lp_delivery4_report import lifecycle_profiles

    return dict(status='passed',cells=sum(map(len,collected.values())),confirmation_cells=len(collected['confirmation']),decisions=len(decisions),all_numerical_values_exact=True,profile_partition_exact=True,no_solver_or_device_execution=True)

if __name__=='__main__':
    p=argparse.ArgumentParser();p.add_argument('--output');a=p.parse_args();value=replay()
    if a.output:put(a.output,value)
    print(value)

"""Portable all-cell evidence, scoped decisions, exact history and independent closure."""
import argparse
import gzip
import hashlib
import json
import math
import os
import re
from pathlib import Path
import statistics
import subprocess
from lp_delivery4_common import ROOT, BASE, BINARY, CPU_CAPS, GPU_CAPS, NS, LANES, TIERS, load, put, ref, require
from lp_delivery4_budget import accounting, admission_open
from lp_delivery4_stats import summarize as decisions_for
from lp_delivery4_study import validate_manifest
from lp_delivery2_study import matches
DATA=ROOT/'docs/benchmarks/data'


def history():
    allowed={'AGENTS.md','state/active-task.md','state/backlog.yaml','docs/plans/gpu-lp-precision-roadmap.md'}
    rows=[]
    for record in subprocess.check_output(['git','ls-tree','-rz','--full-tree','eac5d00'],cwd=ROOT).split(b'\0'):
        if not record:continue
        metadata,name=record.split(b'\t',1);mode,kind,blob=metadata.split();name=name.decode()
        if name in allowed:continue
        require(kind==b'blob','historical gitlink')
        raw=os.readlink(ROOT/name).encode() if mode==b'120000' else (ROOT/name).read_bytes()
        digest=hashlib.sha1(b'blob '+str(len(raw)).encode()+b'\0'+raw).hexdigest()
        require(digest==blob.decode(),'historical source changed: '+name);rows.append(dict(path=name,git_blob=digest))
    for name in ('AGENTS.md','state/active-task.md'):
        old=subprocess.check_output(['git','show','eac5d00:'+name],cwd=ROOT).decode().split('\n\n',1)[1]
        require((ROOT/name).read_text().endswith(old),'older handoff modified')
    return dict(baseline='eac5d00',preserved=rows,allowed=sorted(allowed),older_handoffs_exact=True)


def compressed(path,value):
    with Path(path).open('xb') as stream:
        stream.write(gzip.compress(json.dumps(value,sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':'),allow_nan=False).encode(),compresslevel=6,mtime=0));stream.flush();os.fsync(stream.fileno())
    return ref(path)


def median_rows(rows):
    groups={}
    for row in rows:
        key=tuple(row[k] for k in ('lifecycle','family','lane','tier','role','variant'))
        groups.setdefault(key,[]).append(row)
    result=[]
    for key,group in groups.items():
        records=[r for row in group for r in row['records']]
        phases=sorted(set().union(*(r['costs_ns'] for r in records)))
        result.append(dict(zip(('lifecycle','family','lane','tier','role','variant'),key),
            samples=len(group),complete_ms=statistics.median(r['complete_ns'] for r in group)/1e6,
            first_solve_ms=statistics.median(r['records'][0]['complete_ns'] for r in group)/1e6,
            solve_ms=statistics.median(r['solve_ns'] for r in records)/1e6,
            setup_ms=statistics.median(r['setup_ns'] for r in records)/1e6,
            gpu_ms=statistics.median(r['gpu_us'] for r in records)/1000,
            physical=statistics.median(r['physical'] for r in records),
            costs_ms={phase:statistics.median(r['costs_ns'].get(phase,0) for r in records)/1e6 for phase in phases}))
    return result


def correlation(values):
    a,b=values[:-1],values[1:]
    ma,mb=statistics.mean(a),statistics.mean(b)
    covariance=sum((x-ma)*(y-mb) for x,y in zip(a,b))
    scale=math.sqrt(sum((x-ma)**2 for x in a)*sum((y-mb)**2 for y in b))
    return covariance/scale if scale else None


def lifecycle_profiles(rows, logs=None):
    observations=[]
    for row in rows:
        record=row['records'][0]
        log=ROOT/record['result']['path'];log=log.with_name(row['id']+'.stderr')
        events=[json.loads(line) for line in (log.read_text() if logs is None else logs[row['id']]).splitlines()]
        processes=[e['delivery4_process'] for e in events if 'delivery4_process' in e]
        parent=next(p for p in processes if p['role']=='once')
        child=next(p for p in processes if p['role']=='check-service')
        scopes=parent['costs']['scopes']
        def exact(path):return sum(s['inclusive_ns'] for s in scopes if s['path']==path)

                require(elapsed>=value['solve_ns'],'complete solve boundary')
                records.append(dict(complete_ns=elapsed,result=ref(dest),solve_ns=value['solve_ns'],costs_ns=value['costs_ns'],setup_ns=value['setup_ns'],gpu_us=value['gpu_us'],physical=value['physical'],certified=value['certified'],status=value['status'],delivery=service.last_delivery))
        finally:
            ended=time.monotonic_ns();service.close();teardown=time.monotonic_ns()-ended
    elapsed=time.monotonic_ns()-start
    require(len(records)==(3 if cell['lifecycle']=='prepared' else 1),'fresh solve count')
    require(all(r['certified']==(cell['family']!='infinite-bound-refusal') for r in records),'certificate coverage')
    row=dict(**cell,complete_ns=statistics.median(r['complete_ns'] for r in records),certified=all(r['certified'] for r in records),
        records=records,setup=setup,teardown_ns=teardown,batch_with_analysis_ns=elapsed)
    put(out/(cell['id']+'.cell.json'),row)
    return row


def execute_block(directory,block):
    directory=Path(directory);manifest=load(directory/'manifest.json');validate_manifest(manifest)
    require(0<=block<manifest['blocks'],'unknown block')
    out=directory/f'block-{block:02d}';out.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
    put(out/'STARTED.json',dict(manifest=ref(directory/'manifest.json'),block=block,environment=snapshot()))
    rows=[];cell=None
    try:
        for cell in [c for c in manifest['cells'] if c['block']==block]:
            rows.append(run_cell(out,cell,manifest))
            if len(rows)%32==0:print(dict(block=block,completed=len(rows)),flush=True)
    except BaseException as error:
        put(out/'partial.json',dict(status='failed',error=repr(error),failed_cell=cell,rows=rows,unexecuted=[c['id'] for c in manifest['cells'] if c['block']==block and c['id'] not in {r['id'] for r in rows} and c!=cell]))
        raise
    put(out/'result.json',dict(status='complete',rows=rows,environment=snapshot()))
    print(dict(block=block,completed=len(rows)),flush=True)


def collect(directory):
    directory=Path(directory);manifest=load(directory/'manifest.json');validate_manifest(manifest);rows=[];blocks=[]
    for block in range(manifest['blocks']):
        path=directory/f'block-{block:02d}'/'result.json';r=load(path)
        require(r['status']=='complete','incomplete block');rows+=r['rows'];blocks.append(ref(path))
    require(len(rows)==len(manifest['cells']) and {r['id'] for r in rows}=={c['id'] for c in manifest['cells']},'incomplete cohort')
    put(directory/'result.json',dict(status='complete',manifest=ref(directory/'manifest.json'),rows=rows,blocks=blocks))
    print(dict(cells=len(rows),solves=sum(len(r['records']) for r in rows)),flush=True)

if __name__=='__main__':
    p=argparse.ArgumentParser();p.add_argument('action',choices=['freeze','block','collect']);p.add_argument('directory');p.add_argument('--kind',choices=['profile','diagnostic','confirmation']);p.add_argument('--block',type=int);a=p.parse_args()
    if a.action=='freeze':freeze(a.directory,a.kind)
    elif a.action=='block':execute_block(a.directory,a.block)
    else:collect(a.directory)

"""Bounded fresh-session delivery; complete time ends after durable response."""
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import select
import subprocess
import time
from lp_delivery2_transport import durable
from lp_delivery4_common import BINARY, require
from lp_delivery4_cpu import environment

class Service:
    def __init__(self, image, model, log, equilibrate=True, variant=None, profile=None):
        self.log_path = Path(log)
        self.log = self.log_path.open('xb')
        self.buffer = bytearray()
        self.solve_id = self.generation = 0
        variant = variant or os.environ.get('GPUP_DELIVERY4_VARIANT','control')
        profile = os.environ.get('GPUP_DELIVERY4_PROFILE') == '1' if profile is None else profile
        self.profile = profile
        self.last_delivery = None
        try:
            self.proc = subprocess.Popen([str(BINARY),'serve',str(image),str(model)]+([] if equilibrate else ['unscaled']),
                stdin=subprocess.PIPE,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=self.log,env=environment(variant,profile),bufsize=0)
            self.ready = self.read()
            require(self.ready['ready'] and self.ready['delivery_variant'] == variant, 'readiness/configuration binding')
        except BaseException:
            if hasattr(self,'proc'):
                self.proc.kill(); self.proc.wait()
            self.log.close()
            raise

    def line(self, timeout=35):
        deadline=time.monotonic()+timeout
        while b'\n' not in self.buffer:
            remaining=deadline-time.monotonic()
            if remaining <= 0 or not select.select([self.proc.stdout],[],[],max(0,remaining))[0]:
                durable(str(self.log_path)+'.stdout.partial',bytes(self.buffer))
                raise TimeoutError('service response deadline')
            data=os.read(self.proc.stdout.fileno(),min(65536,(8<<20)+1-len(self.buffer)))
            if not data:
                if self.buffer: durable(str(self.log_path)+'.stdout.partial',bytes(self.buffer))
                raise RuntimeError(f'GPU service ended: {self.proc.poll()}')
            self.buffer.extend(data)
            if len(self.buffer) > 8<<20:
                durable(str(self.log_path)+'.stdout.partial',bytes(self.buffer))
                raise RuntimeError('response frame limit')
        end=self.buffer.index(b'\n')+1
        value=bytes(self.buffer[:end]); del self.buffer[:end]
        return value

    def read(self):
        return json.loads(self.line())

    def write(self, command):
        payload=(json.dumps(command,separators=(',',':'),allow_nan=False)+'\n').encode()
        # FileIO.write may short-write large frames; write until all bytes arrive.
        view=memoryview(payload)
        while view:
            n=self.proc.stdin.write(view)
            if not n: raise BrokenPipeError('command write stopped')
            view=view[n:]
        self.proc.stdin.flush()

    def call(self, op, **fields):
        self.write(dict(op=op,solve_id=self.solve_id,generation=self.generation,**fields))
        result=self.read()
        if op=='solve': self.solve_id+=1; self.generation=0
        elif op=='debug_finish': self.solve_id=result['solve_id']; self.generation=0
        else: self.generation=result.get('generation',self.generation)
        return result

    def solve_to_file(self, path, **fields):
        started=time.monotonic_ns()
        self.write(dict(op='solve',solve_id=self.solve_id,generation=0,**fields))
        sent=time.monotonic_ns() if self.profile else None
        line=self.line()
        received=time.monotonic_ns() if self.profile else None
        durable(path,line)
        elapsed=time.monotonic_ns()-started
        self.last_delivery=dict(send_ns=sent-started,receive_end_ns=received-started,durable_end_ns=elapsed) if self.profile else None
        result=json.loads(line); self.solve_id+=1; self.generation=0
        return result,elapsed

    def close(self, expected=0):
        if self.log.closed: return
        if not self.proc.stdin.closed: self.proc.stdin.close()
        try:
            try: code=self.proc.wait(timeout=10)
            except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
                self.proc.kill(); self.proc.wait(); raise
            require(code==expected,f'service exit {code}')
        finally:
            self.log.flush(); os.fsync(self.log.fileno()); self.log.close()
            self.proc.stdout.close()


def deliver(command,dest,log,timeout,profile=False):
    started=time.monotonic_ns()
    try:
        result=subprocess.run(command,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE,timeout=timeout)
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired as error:
        durable(str(dest)+'.partial',error.stdout or b'');durable(log,error.stderr or b'');raise
    reaped=time.monotonic_ns() if profile else None
    durable(dest,result.stdout);durable(log,result.stderr)
    elapsed=time.monotonic_ns()-started
    result.check_returncode()
    spans=dict(process_exit_ns=reaped-started,durable_end_ns=elapsed) if profile else None
    return elapsed,spans

Status: accepted for the user's DELIVERY4 implementation request (2026-11-12)

[DELIVERY3 diagnosis](../benchmarks/lp-delivery3-diagnosis.md) bounds cold arithmetic-
only gain at about 1.0094x and identifies serial host preparation plus a large
unclassified outer remainder. Implement [SPEC-0035](../specifications/SPEC-0035-delivery4.md)
in a separate research package, measuring CPU startup first and device lifecycle
only after exact CPU admission. Preserve original input admission, numerical
order, independent checking and complete EOF/durability/cleanup costs.

Select one evidence-supported startup/lifecycle optimization and a new bounded
pilot before freezing a cold-only confirmation against the strong DELIVERY3
overlap control. Keep prospective scoped 1.10x benefit and material-regression
guards; all old results and allocations remain exact. Prepared and mixed-precision
work stay separate. Report negative and inconclusive results as well as gains.

# SPEC-0035: measured cold startup and lifecycle delivery

The user requests DELIVERY4 implementation. Follow the
[delivery plan](../plans/lp-delivery4.md) and [ADR-0068](../decisions/ADR-0068-delivery4.md).
New code belongs to `research/lp-delivery4` and new tooling. Preserve historical
sources/evidence and all numerical state-machine, checker, signed-zero, refusal,
checkpoint, recovery, cancellation and original-model 1e-7/1e-9 contracts.

## Measurement and selection

First run CPU-only attribution on retained original models: solver/checker data
construction, JSON/LP scopes, model/image/executable hashing. Preserve sources,
all repetitions and fixed alternating operation order. These warmed measurements
are attribution, not a substitute for complete cold latency.

Add optional process-wide hierarchical scopes and explicit setup/response/owned
teardown spans. Include output construction, checker EOF/reaping, device buffer,
module/stream/context destruction, parent collection and durable writes. Both
profiled and unprofiled cold boundaries end after process exit and durability.
Profiles are diagnostic only. Never sum parent/child overlapping timers.

Choose and document one concrete change from the measured cost case. Control is
DELIVERY3 overlap-only in the new executable, same both lanes and final tiers.
Candidate must preserve early invalid-input refusal and independent checking;
no new CUDA work may precede successful original-model admission. No public
default, precision change or outcome-dependent dispatcher.

Before device work, pass CPU exact representation/checker differentials and the
full native gate. Admit unchanged-image lifecycle/cancellation/failure behavior,
configuration and profiling modes. Reuse only source-bound unchanged device
sanitizer evidence. Device pilot: two profiled and four unprofiled fresh blocks,
four declared families (dense512, coupled equality, fixed bounds, irregular33),
both lanes/tiers, paired control/candidate, cold only: 192 cells. Separately check
prepared reuse in admission. Retain all values and failures. Freeze the candidate
only if the uninstrumented dense512 geometric paired ratio is at least 1.01;
otherwise report the negative pilot without launching confirmation.

## New confirmation protocol

Freeze sources, executables, schedule, candidate and reducer after admission and
pilot. Thirty-two new blocks, twelve original families, both lanes/tiers and
control/candidate cold pairs: 3072 cells. Counterbalance each pair order 16/16,
randomize stratum order with a new recorded seed. All bounded families must
certify; the intentional unbounded-direction refusal stays visible. Every original
endpoint, certificate (apart from binary binding), audit, checkpoint, recovery and
physical/logical work must match. No retry of a started frozen scientific identity.

For each lane/tier: median of block-wise equal-weight geometric ratios over
original dense128/256/512; benefit lower bound >=1.10x. Each of eleven certified
families uses paired `candidate-control-max(2%*control,0.10 ms)` and requires its
median interval upper bound <=0. Four benefits and 44 guards (48 metrics) use
Bonferroni two-sided 95% distribution-free binomial median intervals. Compute the
ranks exactly before freezing. Preserve supported, unfavorable and inconclusive
outcomes and shared-device/independence limitations. Prepared throughput and
TENSOR2's separate retention contract are unchanged.

## Independent resources and delivery

Ceiling 64000 CPU / 4800 GPU seconds. CPU phases: implementation 12000 (512
preparation), native 12000, acceptance 8000, diagnosis 8000, confirmation 16000,
reporting 6000, cleanup 2000 (128 closing administration). GPU: acceptance 600,
diagnosis 600, confirmation 3600. Four CPU slots, 16 GiB sampled RSS, at most
12 GiB owned device buffers, one pinned shared lease and unchanged in-container
supervisor. Confirmation blocks reserve <=90 GPU /360 CPU seconds each.
Every whole job must fit; preserve failed reservations and development versions.
Receipts: `artifacts/gpup-delivery4-v1`. No old allocation transfer.

Record useful diagnosis findings and limits in a durable report and current
handoffs, along with all results, sources, exact historical preservation, software
acceptance and final accounting. Commit locally only; no push/publication or GPUP-9.

# GPUP-DELIVERY4 isolated cold executor

Implements [SPEC-0035](../../docs/specifications/SPEC-0035-delivery4.md).
`GPUP_DELIVERY4_VARIANT=control|candidate` selects the DELIVERY3 overlap control
or exact SHA-256 acceleration; the default is control. Both retain unbuffered
transport, independent original-model checking, identical numerical state
machines and input validation before CUDA setup. Public solver defaults stay exact.

`GPUP_DELIVERY4_PROFILE=1` enables optional hierarchical lifecycle diagnostics.
It is disabled in confirmation. Complete cold measurements end after process
exit and durable output. Prepared reuse is admitted but is not a throughput claim.

Run `bash tools/check_delivery4_cpu.sh` from the repository with its provisioned
Rust/native/Python environment. That script includes the isolated dependency policy and metadata audit rejecting
external wildcards. The task receipt launcher separately writes once into its
independent artifact allocation.
Device execution requires the pinned inherited lease and separately admitted
source-bound protocol; these commands do not release a new experiment.

[Delivery and retained findings](../../docs/benchmarks/lp-delivery4.md).

        certified=family!='infinite-bound-refusal')

    def test_exact_simultaneous_rank_and_unbounded_small_sample(self):
        ci=interval(list(range(32)));self.assertEqual(ci['ranks'],[7,26]);self.assertEqual((ci['lower'],ci['upper']),(6,25))
        self.assertLessEqual(sum(math.comb(32,i) for i in range(7))*40*48,2**32)
        self.assertGreater(sum(math.comb(32,i) for i in range(8))*40*48,2**32)
        self.assertIsNone(interval([1,2,3])['lower'])
        self.assertEqual(classify(interval([2]*3),1.1,True),'inconclusive')
        for bad in ([],[float('nan')],[float('inf')]):
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError):interval(bad)

    def test_thresholds_ties_and_inconclusive(self):
        self.assertEqual(classify(interval([1.1]*32),1.1,True),'supported')
        self.assertEqual(classify(interval([1.0]*32),1.1,True),'insufficient-benefit')
        self.assertEqual(classify(interval([0.0]*32),0.0,False),'supported')
        self.assertEqual(classify(interval([-.1]*16+[.1]*16),0.0,False),'inconclusive')
        self.assertEqual(classify(interval([.1]*32),0.0,False),'material-regression')

    def test_target_benefit_and_small_families_are_separate(self):
        decisions=summarize(cohort(),FAMILIES)
        self.assertEqual(len(decisions),4)
        self.assertTrue(all(d['decision']=='supported' for d in decisions))
        self.assertEqual(sum(1+len(d['guards']) for d in decisions),48)

    def test_material_regression_and_missing_cells_cannot_hide(self):
        rows=cohort()
        for row in rows:
            if row['role']=='candidate' and row['family']=='coupled-equality':row['complete_ns']=21_000_000
        self.assertTrue(all(d['decision']=='material-regression' for d in summarize(rows,FAMILIES)))
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):summarize(rows[:-1],FAMILIES)
        rows[-1]=copy.deepcopy(rows[0])
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):summarize(rows,FAMILIES)

    def test_certification_or_refusal_change_vetoes_retention(self):
        rows=cohort()
        for row in rows:
            if row['role']=='candidate' and row['family']=='dense-generic-512':row['certified']=False
        self.assertTrue(all(d['decision']=='correctness-or-coverage-failure' for d in summarize(rows,FAMILIES)))
        rows=cohort()
        for row in rows:
            if row['family']=='infinite-bound-refusal':row['certified']=True
        self.assertTrue(all(d['decision']=='correctness-or-coverage-failure' for d in summarize(rows,FAMILIES)))

    def test_truncated_pipe_is_preserved(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as temp:
            service=Service.__new__(Service);service.buffer=bytearray();service.log_path=Path(temp)/'stderr'
            service.proc=subprocess.Popen([sys.executable,'-c','import sys; sys.stdout.write("partial")'],stdout=subprocess.PIPE)
            try:
                with self.assertRaises(RuntimeError):service.line(3)
                self.assertEqual(Path(str(service.log_path)+'.stdout.partial').read_bytes(),b'partial')
            finally:service.proc.wait();service.proc.stdout.close()

    def test_short_writes_complete_the_frame(self):
        class Short(io.BytesIO):
            def write(self,data):return super().write(data[:3])
        writer=Short();service=Service.__new__(Service);service.proc=types.SimpleNamespace(stdin=writer)
        service.write({'op':'solve','value':-0.0})
        self.assertEqual(writer.getvalue(),b'{"op":"solve","value":-0.0}\n')

    def test_closed_allocation_is_not_reused(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as temp:
            base=Path(temp);(base/'CLOSED.json').write_text('{}')
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError):admission_open(base)

        require(load(BASE/'resources'/f'{name}.settlement.json')['status']=='passed','CPU/native gate incomplete')
    require(load(BASE/'cpu-v1/manifest.json')['binary']==ref(BINARY),'admitted executable changed')
    parent=load(PARENT/'manifest.json');image=ROOT/parent['image']['path']
    require(ref(image)==parent['image'],'device image changed')
    for binding in parent['sources']:require(ref(ROOT/binding['path'])==binding,'historical source changed')
    require(load(ROOT/'docs/benchmarks/data/fp4-checker-acceptance-v1.json')['status']=='passed','unchanged-image sanitizer admission')
    numerical_source();out=BASE/'device-v1';out.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
    lifecycle.BINARY=BINARY;lifecycle.Service=Service;rows={}
    for variant in VARIANTS:
        env=environment(variant)
        for key in ('GPUP_DELIVERY2_CONTROL','GPUP_CHECKER_ORIGINAL','GPUP_DELIVERY3_VARIANT','GPUP_DELIVERY3_PROFILE'):os.environ.pop(key,None)
        os.environ['GPUP_DELIVERY4_VARIANT']=env['GPUP_DELIVERY4_VARIANT'];os.environ['GPUP_DELIVERY4_PROFILE']='0'
        lifecycle.run(image,out/variant);rows[variant]=load(out/variant/'result.json')['rows']
    require(all(len(r)==42 for r in rows.values()),'lifecycle coverage')
    for variant in VARIANTS[1:]:
        for control,candidate in zip(rows['control'],rows[variant]):
            require(control['case']==candidate['case'],'case order')
            for key in ('first','second','result'):
                if key in control:matches(candidate[key],control[key],ref(BINARY))
    failures=[]
    for variant,profile in itertools.product(VARIANTS,(False,True)):
        result=subprocess.run([str(BINARY),'serve',str(image)+'.missing',str(ROOT/parent['models']['dense-generic-512']['path'])],capture_output=True,timeout=15,env=environment(variant,profile))
        require(result.returncode!=0 and not result.stdout,'missing module became ready')
        failures.append(dict(variant=variant,profile=profile,returncode=result.returncode,stderr=result.stderr.decode()))
    put(out/'startup-failures.json',failures)
    original=load(ROOT/parent['models']['coupled-equality']['path'])
    malformed={'syntax':b'{'}
    value=copy.deepcopy(original);value['variables'][0]['domain']='integer';malformed['domain']=json.dumps(value).encode()
    value=copy.deepcopy(original);value['variables'][0]['upper']={'kind':'finite','value':-2.0};malformed['bounds']=json.dumps(value).encode()
    early=[]
    for name,raw in malformed.items():
        path=out/(name+'.model.json');path.write_bytes(raw)
        for variant in VARIANTS:
            result=subprocess.run([str(BINARY),'serve',str(image),str(path)],capture_output=True,timeout=10,env=environment(variant,True))
            require(result.returncode!=0 and not result.stdout,'invalid original model became ready')
            events=[json.loads(line) for line in result.stderr.splitlines() if line.startswith(b'{')]
            process=next(e['delivery4_process'] for e in events if 'delivery4_process' in e)
            require(not process['success'],'invalid model success')
            require(all('device_context' not in scope['path'] for scope in process['costs']['scopes']),'CUDA preceded model admission')
            early.append(dict(case=name,variant=variant,returncode=result.returncode,stderr=result.stderr.decode()))
    put(out/'early-refusals.json',early)
    smoke=out/'smoke';smoke.mkdir();cells=[]
    for profile,family,variant,lane,tier in itertools.product((False,True),('coupled-equality','dense-generic-512','ill-scaled-generic-128','infinite-bound-refusal'),VARIANTS,LANES,TIERS):
        old=next(c for c in parent['cells'] if c['family']==family and c['lane']==lane and c['tier']==tier and c['lifecycle']=='prepared' and c['repetition']==0)
        cell=dict(id=f'{profile}-{family}-{variant}-{lane}-{tier}',block=0,family=family,variant=variant,lane=lane,tier=tier,lifecycle='prepared',role=variant,original_result=ref(PARENT/(old['id']+'.json')))
        manifest=dict(profile=profile,image=parent['image'],models=parent['models'],settings=parent['settings'],binary=ref(BINARY),prepared_solves=3)
        row=run_cell(smoke,cell,manifest)
        for record in row['records']:
            result=load(ROOT/record['result']['path'])
            require(('delivery_profile' in result)==profile,'profile mode changed')
            if profile:
                for p in result['delivery_profile']['assessments']:
                    require(0<=p['request_build_encode_write_flush_ns']<=p['response_wait_read_end_ns']<=p['response_decode_end_ns']<=p['binding_end_ns'],'parent response span order')
        cells.append(row)
    put(out/'result.json',dict(status='passed',lifecycle_cases=84,setup_failures=4,early_refusals=len(early),smoke_cells=len(cells),smoke_solves=sum(len(c['records']) for c in cells),rows=cells,
        image=parent['image'],binary=ref(BINARY),source=numerical_source(),prior_sanitizer_admission=ref(ROOT/'docs/benchmarks/data/fp4-checker-acceptance-v1.json')))
    print(dict(status='passed',lifecycle_cases=84,setup_failures=4,early_refusals=len(early),smoke_cells=len(cells)),flush=True)

if __name__=='__main__':run()

"""Independent DELIVERY4 reservations using the unchanged CPU supervisor."""
import argparse
import fcntl
import os
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys
import time

from lp_delivery4_common import (BASE, CPU_CAPS, DEVICE, GPU_CAPS, NS, ROOT,
                                load, put, ref, require)


def accounting(base=BASE):
    cpu = {k: 0 for k in CPU_CAPS}
    gpu = {k: 0 for k in GPU_CAPS}
    # Separate continuation allocation; prior charges remain in their closed ledgers.
    cpu['implementation'] = 512 * NS
    for p in sorted((base / 'resources').glob('*.reservation.json')):
        r = load(p)
        result = p.with_name(p.name.replace('.reservation.json', '.settlement.json'))
        s = load(result) if result.exists() else r
        cpu[r['phase']] += s['cpu_ns']
        if r['gpu']:
            gpu[r['phase']] += s['gpu_ns']
    return cpu, gpu


def admission_open(base=BASE):
    require(not (base/"CLOSED.json").exists(), "allocation is closed")
    for p in (base/'resources').glob('*.settlement.json'):
        require(not load(p)['overrun'], 'prior resource overrun closes execution')
    for p in (base/'resources').glob('*.reservation.json'):
        require(p.with_name(p.name.replace('.reservation.json','.settlement.json')).exists(),
                'unsettled reservation closes execution')


def run(identity, phase, seconds, gpu, command, base=BASE):
    require(identity and Path(identity).name == identity, 'invalid job identity')
    require(phase in CPU_CAPS and type(seconds) is int and seconds >= 3, 'invalid reservation')
    require(not gpu or phase in GPU_CAPS, 'GPU phase invalid')
    directory = base / 'resources'
    directory.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    # Serialize reservations as well as numerical jobs; no lost-update allowance.
    with (base / 'budget.lock').open('a+b') as budget_lock:
        fcntl.flock(budget_lock, fcntl.LOCK_EX)
        admission_open(base)
        cpu, used_gpu = accounting(base)
        require(cpu[phase] + 4 * seconds * NS <= CPU_CAPS[phase] * NS, 'CPU phase exhausted')
        require(not gpu or used_gpu[phase] + seconds * NS <= GPU_CAPS[phase] * NS, 'GPU phase exhausted')
        prefix = directory / identity
        # Every development attempt has immutable source bytes, including failures.
        frozen = base / 'sources' / identity
        frozen.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
        paths = list((ROOT/'research/lp-delivery4').glob('src/*.rs'))
        paths += list((ROOT/'research/lp-delivery4').glob('cuda/*'))
        paths += list((ROOT/'research/lp-delivery4').glob('Cargo.*'))
        paths += [ROOT/'research/lp-delivery4/deny.toml', ROOT/'research/lp-delivery4/README.md', ROOT/'docs/specifications/SPEC-0035-delivery4.md', ROOT/'docs/decisions/ADR-0068-delivery4.md']
        paths += list((ROOT/'tools').glob('*delivery4*.py'))
        paths += list((ROOT/'tests/integration').glob('*delivery4*.py'))
        refs = []
        for path in sorted(paths):
            dest = frozen / path.relative_to(ROOT)
            dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            dest.write_bytes(path.read_bytes())
            refs.append(ref(dest))
        put(frozen/'manifest.json', dict(sources=refs))
        put(str(prefix) + '.reservation.json', dict(phase=phase, gpu=gpu,
            cpu_ns=4 * seconds * NS, gpu_ns=seconds * NS if gpu else 0, command=command,
            device=DEVICE if gpu else None, supervisor=ref(ROOT / 'tools/lp_cpu_admission.py')))
        put(str(prefix) + '.cpu-journal.json', dict(identity='gpup-delivery4-job-v1',
            prior_cpu_ns=0, ceiling_cpu_ns=4 * seconds * NS, active=None, failed=False, runs=[],
            stages={phase: dict(cap_cpu_ns=4 * seconds * NS, charged_cpu_ns=0)}))
        env = {**os.environ, 'CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES': DEVICE if gpu else '',
               'COPT_HOME':'/root/copt80', 'COPT_LICENSE_DIR':'/root/copt80'}
        queued = time.monotonic_ns()
        lock = None
        try:
            if gpu:
                lock = open(os.environ.get('AI_OPTIMIZER_GPU_LOCK', '/tmp/ai-optimizer-gpu.lock'), 'a+b')
                while True:
                    try:
                        fcntl.flock(lock, fcntl.LOCK_EX | fcntl.LOCK_NB)
                        break
                    except BlockingIOError:
                        require(time.monotonic_ns() - queued < 300 * NS, 'GPU lease wait expired')
                        time.sleep(.1)
                env['AI_OPTIMIZER_GPU_LEASE'] = 'inherited'
            acquired = time.monotonic_ns()
            # Invoke run() through a small entrypoint so new stage names do not
            # change the retained supervisor's historical argparse choices.
            request = dict(stage=phase, reserve_cpu_seconds=4 * seconds,
                output=str(prefix) + '.resource.json', log=str(prefix) + '.resource.json.log',
                journal=str(prefix) + '.cpu-journal.json', lock=str(base / 'cpu.lock'),
                slots=4, declared_memory_bytes=15 << 30, rss_stop_bytes=16 << 30,
                address_space_bytes=0, sources=[], bootstrap=False, show_log=False,
                max_gap_ns=100_000_000, command=command)
            request_path = str(prefix) + '.request.json'
            put(request_path, request)
            args = [sys.executable, '-B', str(ROOT / 'tools/lp_delivery4_budget.py'),
                    '_supervise', request_path]
            child = subprocess.run(args, env=env, pass_fds=() if lock is None else (lock.fileno(),))
            elapsed = time.monotonic_ns() - acquired
            receipt = Path(request['output'])
            report = load(receipt) if receipt.exists() else None
            success = child.returncode == 0 and report and report['status'] == 'passed'
            charged_cpu = max(report['charged_cpu_ns'] if report else 4 * seconds * NS,
                              4 * elapsed)
            charged_gpu = (elapsed if success else max(elapsed, seconds * NS)) if gpu else 0
            overrun = charged_cpu > 4 * seconds * NS or charged_gpu > seconds * NS
            settlement = dict(phase=phase, gpu=gpu, cpu_ns=charged_cpu, gpu_ns=charged_gpu,
                status='passed' if success and not overrun else 'refused', overrun=overrun,
                queue_ns=acquired-queued, resource=ref(receipt) if report else None)
            put(str(prefix) + '.settlement.json', settlement)
            return settlement
        finally:
            if lock:
                lock.close()


def main():
    if len(sys.argv) == 3 and sys.argv[1] == '_supervise':
        import lp_cpu_admission
        report = lp_cpu_admission.run(load(sys.argv[2]))
        return 0 if report['status'] == 'passed' else 2
    p = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    p.add_argument('--id', required=True)
    p.add_argument('--phase', choices=CPU_CAPS, required=True)
    p.add_argument('--seconds', type=int, required=True)
    p.add_argument('--gpu', action='store_true')
    p.add_argument('command', nargs=argparse.REMAINDER)
    a = p.parse_args()
    command = a.command[1:] if a.command[:1] == ['--'] else a.command
    result = run(a.id, a.phase, a.seconds, a.gpu, command)
    print(result, flush=True)
    return 0 if result['status'] == 'passed' else 2


if __name__ == '__main__':
    raise SystemExit(main())

"""Exact original serial checker differential and two-way process admission."""
import argparse
import copy
import gzip
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import statistics
import subprocess
from lp_delivery4_common import ROOT, BASE, BINARY, VARIANTS, load, put, ref, require
from lp_delivery2_study import bits
ARCHIVE = ROOT/'docs/benchmarks/data/fp4-accel-result-v1-endpoints.json.gz'


def environment(variant, profile=False):
    require(variant in VARIANTS, 'unknown delivery configuration')
    env = dict(os.environ)
    for name in ('GPUP_DELIVERY2_CONTROL', 'GPUP_CHECKER_ORIGINAL','GPUP_DELIVERY3_VARIANT','GPUP_DELIVERY3_PROFILE'):
        env.pop(name, None)
    env['GPUP_DELIVERY4_VARIANT'] = variant
    env['GPUP_DELIVERY4_PROFILE'] = '1' if profile else '0'
    return env


def numerical_source():
    old = ROOT/'research/lp-delivery3/src/main.rs'
    new = ROOT/'research/lp-delivery4/src/main.rs'
    def body(path):
        text = path.read_text()
        return text[text.index('    fn lane('):text.index('fn main()')]
    require(body(old) == body(new), 'numerical state machine differs')
    original_model=(ROOT/'research/lp-fp4-accel/src/model.rs').read_text()
    require((ROOT/'research/lp-delivery4/src/model.rs').read_text().replace('use crate::identity::hex;\n','')==original_model.replace('use optimizer_experiment::sha256::hex;\n',''),'model arithmetic changed')
    return dict(parent=ref(old), candidate=ref(new), unchanged='lane, preparation, solve, command state machine')


def process_cases(model, endpoint):
    rows = []
    request = dict(endpoint=endpoint, tier='certified-1e-9')
    for variant in VARIANTS:
        for profile in (False, True):
            env = {**environment(variant, profile), 'CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES':''}
            requests = []
            for status in ('completed', 'cancelled', 'limit', 'error', 'refused'):
                value = copy.deepcopy(request); value['endpoint']['transport'] = status; requests.append(value)
            result = subprocess.run([str(BINARY), 'check-service', str(model)], input=b''.join(json.dumps(v).encode()+b'\n' for v in requests), capture_output=True, timeout=15, env=env)
            values = [json.loads(line) for line in result.stdout.splitlines()]
            require(result.returncode == 0 and len(values) == 6, 'fresh checker lifecycle')
            require(values[1]['accepted'] and all(not r['accepted'] for r in values[2:]), 'terminal status authority')
            require(bool(result.stderr) == profile, 'diagnostic instrumentation mode')
            if profile:
                events = [json.loads(line) for line in result.stderr.splitlines()]
                require(len(events) == 7 and 'delivery4_checker_setup' in events[0] and 'delivery4_process' in events[-1], 'diagnostic schema')
                for event in events[1:-1]:
                    p = event['delivery4_checker_assessment']
                    require(0 <= p['decode_ns'] <= p['assessed_ns'] <= p['sent_ns'], 'child timing order')
            rows.append(dict(variant=variant, profile=profile, case='fresh-status-EOF', passed=True))
            malformed = {}
            for key, value in [('model_sha256','wrong'), ('primal',[]), ('dual',[]), ('transport','optimal')]:
                bad = copy.deepcopy(request); bad['endpoint'][key] = value; malformed[key] = json.dumps(bad).encode()+b'\n'
            bad = copy.deepcopy(request); bad['tier'] = 'certified-1e-6'; malformed['tier'] = json.dumps(bad).encode()+b'\n'
            malformed.update(duplicate=b'{"tier":"a","tier":"b","endpoint":null}\n', truncated=json.dumps(request).encode(), oversize=b' '*(8<<20)+b'\n')
            for case, payload in malformed.items():
                r = subprocess.run([str(BINARY),'check-service',str(model)],input=payload,capture_output=True,timeout=15,env=env)
                require(r.returncode != 0 and len(r.stdout.splitlines()) == 1, 'bad request accepted: '+case)
                rows.append(dict(variant=variant,profile=profile,case=case,passed=True))
    for changes in ({'GPUP_DELIVERY4_VARIANT':'auto'}, {'GPUP_DELIVERY4_PROFILE':'yes'}, {'GPUP_DELIVERY2_CONTROL':'1'}, {'GPUP_CHECKER_ORIGINAL':'1'},{'GPUP_DELIVERY3_VARIANT':'overlap'}):
        env = {**environment('control'), **changes, 'CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES':''}
        r = subprocess.run([str(BINARY),'check-service',str(model)],capture_output=True,timeout=10,env=env)
        require(r.returncode != 0 and not r.stdout, 'configuration fail-open')
        rows.append(dict(case='configuration-refusal',changes=changes,passed=True))
    r = subprocess.run([str(BINARY),'check-service',str(model)+'.missing'],capture_output=True,timeout=10,env={**environment('candidate'),'CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES':''})
    require(r.returncode != 0 and not r.stdout,'missing model became ready')
    rows.append(dict(case='missing-model',passed=True))
    return rows


def run(directory, count=3):
    out = Path(directory); out.mkdir(exist_ok=False, parents=True)
    archive = json.loads(gzip.decompress(ARCHIVE.read_bytes()))
    put(out/'manifest.json', dict(binary=ref(BINARY), archive=ref(ARCHIVE), count=count, variants=VARIANTS, source=numerical_source()))
    models=[]
    prior=ROOT/'research/lp-delivery3/target/release/lp-delivery3'
    for family,binding in archive['manifest']['models'].items():
        model=ROOT/binding['path'];require(ref(model)==binding,'original model changed')
        old_env=dict(os.environ)
        for k in ('GPUP_DELIVERY4_VARIANT','GPUP_DELIVERY4_PROFILE','GPUP_DELIVERY2_CONTROL','GPUP_CHECKER_ORIGINAL'):old_env.pop(k,None)
        old_env.update(GPUP_DELIVERY3_VARIANT='overlap',GPUP_DELIVERY3_PROFILE='0',CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES='')
        for unscaled in (False,True):
            args=['inspect',str(model)]+(['unscaled'] if unscaled else [])
            expected=json.loads(subprocess.check_output([str(prior),*args],env=old_env,timeout=30))
            for variant in VARIANTS:
                observed=json.loads(subprocess.check_output([str(BINARY),*args],env={**environment(variant),'CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES':''},timeout=30))
                require(bits(expected)==bits(observed),'original model representation changed')
                models.append(dict(family=family,unscaled=unscaled,variant=variant,exact=True))
    put(out/'representations.json',dict(prior=ref(prior),rows=models))
    rows = []
    for index,(key,value) in enumerate(archive['endpoints'].items()):
        endpoint = out/(key+'.endpoint.json'); put(endpoint,value['endpoint'])
        model = ROOT/archive['manifest']['models'][value['family']]['path']
        require(ref(model) == archive['manifest']['models'][value['family']], 'changed original model')
        expected = {k:v for k,v in value['certificate'].items() if k != 'checker_binary_sha256'}
        for variant in (VARIANTS if index%2 == 0 else VARIANTS[::-1]):
            dest = out/(key+'-'+variant+'.json')
            subprocess.run([str(BINARY),'transport-profile',str(model),str(endpoint),value['tier'],str(count),str(dest)],check=True,capture_output=True,timeout=30,env={**environment(variant),'CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES':''})
            result = load(dest)
            for row in result['rows']:
                require(bits({k:v for k,v in row['certificate'].items() if k != 'checker_binary_sha256'}) == bits(expected), 'serial receipt mismatch')
                require(row['certificate']['checker_binary_sha256'] == ref(BINARY)['sha256'], 'checker executable binding')
            rows.append(dict(key=key,family=value['family'],tier=value['tier'],variant=variant,accepted=expected['accepted'],median_ns=statistics.median(r['ns'] for r in result['rows']),setup_ns=result['setup_ns'],profile=ref(dest)))
        if (index+1)%20 == 0: print(dict(endpoints=index+1),flush=True)
    value = next(v for v in archive['endpoints'].values() if v['family']=='coupled-equality' and v['certificate']['accepted'])
    cases = process_cases(ROOT/archive['manifest']['models'][value['family']]['path'],value['endpoint'])
    put(out/'result.json', dict(status='passed',endpoints=len(archive['endpoints']),fresh_assessments=len(rows)*count,representations=ref(out/'representations.json'),rows=rows,process_cases=cases))
    print(dict(endpoints=len(archive['endpoints']),fresh_assessments=len(rows)*count,process_cases=len(cases)),flush=True)

if __name__ == '__main__':
    p=argparse.ArgumentParser(); p.add_argument('directory'); p.add_argument('--count',type=int,default=3); a=p.parse_args(); run(a.directory,a.count)

"""CPU-only exact replay of DELIVERY4 portable evidence and frozen decisions."""
import argparse
import gzip
import hashlib
import json
from lp_delivery4_common import ROOT,load,ref,require,put
from lp_delivery4_stats import summarize
from lp_delivery2_study import matches,bits


def bound(binding):
    path=ROOT/binding['path'];require(ref(path)==binding,'portable binding differs')
    return json.loads(gzip.decompress(path.read_bytes()))


def replay():
    result=load(ROOT/'docs/benchmarks/data/delivery4-result-v1.json')
    portable=bound(result['cohorts_archive']);groups=portable['cohorts']
    for family,raw in portable['model_bytes'].items():
        require(hashlib.sha256(raw.encode()).hexdigest()==groups['confirmation']['manifest']['models'][family]['sha256'],'original model bytes changed')
    collected={k:[] for k in groups};logs={}
    for binding in result['archives']:
        archive=bound(binding);kind=archive['kind'];rows=archive['result']['rows'];manifest=groups[kind]['manifest']
        for row in rows:
            original=portable['originals'][row['original_result']['path']]
            for record in row['records']:
                value=archive['outputs'][record['result']['path']]
                matches(value,original,manifest['binary'])
                require(record['certified']==(row['family']!='infinite-bound-refusal'),'coverage changed')
                require(record['solve_ns']==value['solve_ns'] and record['costs_ns']==value['costs_ns'],'timer binding differs')
            if kind=='profile':logs[row['id']]=archive['stderr'][row['id']]
        collected[kind]+=rows
    for kind,rows in collected.items():
        require(bits(rows)==bits(groups[kind]['result']['rows']),'archive/cohort rows differ')
        manifest=groups[kind]['manifest'];require(len(rows)==len(manifest['cells']),'incomplete cohort')
        require({r['id'] for r in rows}=={c['id'] for c in manifest['cells']},'identity mismatch')
    decisions=summarize(collected['confirmation'],list(groups['confirmation']['manifest']['models']))
    require(decisions==result['decisions'],'frozen decision mismatch')
    from lp_delivery4_report import lifecycle_profiles
    require(lifecycle_profiles(collected['profile'],logs)==result['profile_lifecycle'],'lifecycle diagnosis differs')
    return dict(status='passed',cells=sum(map(len,collected.values())),confirmation_cells=len(collected['confirmation']),decisions=len(decisions),all_numerical_values_exact=True,profile_partition_exact=True,no_solver_or_device_execution=True)

if __name__=='__main__':
    p=argparse.ArgumentParser();p.add_argument('--output');a=p.parse_args();value=replay()
    if a.output:put(a.output,value)
    print(value)

import hashlib
import json
import math
import os
import re

from lp_delivery4_common import ROOT, BASE, BINARY, CPU_CAPS, GPU_CAPS, NS, LANES, TIERS, load, put, ref, require

DATA=ROOT/'docs/benchmarks/data'


def history():
    allowed={'AGENTS.md','state/active-task.md','state/backlog.yaml','docs/plans/gpu-lp-precision-roadmap.md'}
    rows=[]
    for record in subprocess.check_output(['git','ls-tree','-rz','--full-tree','eac5d00'],cwd=ROOT).split(b'\0'):
        if not record:continue
        metadata,name=record.split(b'\t',1);mode,kind,blob=metadata.split();name=name.decode()
        if name in allowed:continue
        require(kind==b'blob','historical gitlink')
        raw=os.readlink(ROOT/name).encode() if mode==b'120000' else (ROOT/name).read_bytes()
        digest=hashlib.sha1(b'blob '+str(len(raw)).encode()+b'\0'+raw).hexdigest()
        require(digest==blob.decode(),'historical source changed: '+name);rows.append(dict(path=name,git_blob=digest))
    for name in ('AGENTS.md','state/active-task.md'):
        old=subprocess.check_output(['git','show','eac5d00:'+name],cwd=ROOT).decode().split('\n\n',1)[1]
        require((ROOT/name).read_text().endswith(old),'older handoff modified')
    return dict(baseline='eac5d00',preserved=rows,allowed=sorted(allowed),older_handoffs_exact=True)


def compressed(path,value):
    with Path(path).open('xb') as stream:
        stream.write(gzip.compress(json.dumps(value,sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':'),allow_nan=False).encode(),compresslevel=6,mtime=0));stream.flush();os.fsync(stream.fileno())
    return ref(path)


def median_rows(rows):
    groups={}
    for row in rows:
        key=tuple(row[k] for k in ('lifecycle','family','lane','tier','role','variant'))
        groups.setdefault(key,[]).append(row)
    result=[]
    for key,group in groups.items():
        records=[r for row in group for r in row['records']]
        phases=sorted(set().union(*(r['costs_ns'] for r in records)))
        result.append(dict(zip(('lifecycle','family','lane','tier','role','variant'),key),
            samples=len(group),complete_ms=statistics.median(r['complete_ns'] for r in group)/1e6,
            first_solve_ms=statistics.median(r['records'][0]['complete_ns'] for r in group)/1e6,
            solve_ms=statistics.median(r['solve_ns'] for r in records)/1e6,
            setup_ms=statistics.median(r['setup_ns'] for r in records)/1e6,
            gpu_ms=statistics.median(r['gpu_us'] for r in records)/1000,
            physical=statistics.median(r['physical'] for r in records),
            costs_ms={phase:statistics.median(r['costs_ns'].get(phase,0) for r in records)/1e6 for phase in phases}))
    return result


def correlation(values):
    a,b=values[:-1],values[1:]
    ma,mb=statistics.mean(a),statistics.mean(b)
    covariance=sum((x-ma)*(y-mb) for x,y in zip(a,b))
    scale=math.sqrt(sum((x-ma)**2 for x in a)*sum((y-mb)**2 for y in b))
    return covariance/scale if scale else None


def lifecycle_profiles(rows, logs=None):
    observations=[]
    for row in rows:
        record=row['records'][0]
        log=ROOT/record['result']['path'];log=log.with_name(row['id']+'.stderr')
        events=[json.loads(line) for line in (log.read_text() if logs is None else logs[row['id']]).splitlines()]
        processes=[e['delivery4_process'] for e in events if 'delivery4_process' in e]
        parent=next(p for p in processes if p['role']=='once')
        child=next(p for p in processes if p['role']=='check-service')
        scopes=parent['costs']['scopes']
        def exact(path):return sum(s['inclusive_ns'] for s in scopes if s['path']==path)
        setup=exact(['session_setup']);response=exact(['response_construction']);emit=exact(['response_emit']);destruction=exact(['session_destruction'])
        # These root scopes do not overlap. Nested scopes explain their parents.
        require(setup+response+emit+destruction<=parent['main_ns'],'overlapping root accounting')
        outside_main=record['delivery']['process_exit_ns']-parent['main_ns']
        require(outside_main>=0,'process timer boundary')
        parts=dict(setup=setup,solve=record['solve_ns'],response_after_solve=response-record['solve_ns'],response_emit=emit,destruction=destruction,
            unscoped_main=parent['main_ns']-setup-response-emit-destruction,process_entry_exit=outside_main,
            durable_output=record['delivery']['durable_end_ns']-record['delivery']['process_exit_ns'])
        require(all(v>=0 for v in parts.values()) and sum(parts.values())==record['complete_ns'],'complete profile partition')
        observations.append(dict(family=row['family'],lane=row['lane'],tier=row['tier'],variant=row['variant'],block=row['block'],parts_ns=parts,
            destruction_scopes=[s for s in scopes if s['path'][0]=='session_destruction'],parent=parent,child=child))
    groups={}
    for row in observations:groups.setdefault(tuple(row[k] for k in ('family','lane','tier','variant')),[]).append(row)
    return dict(observations=observations,means=[dict(zip(('family','lane','tier','variant'),key),samples=len(group),parts_ms={k:statistics.mean(v['parts_ns'][k] for v in group)/1e6 for k in group[0]['parts_ns']},
        destruction_scopes_ms={str(scope['path']):statistics.mean(sum(s['inclusive_ns'] for s in row['destruction_scopes'] if s['path']==scope['path']) for row in group)/1e6 for scope in group[0]['destruction_scopes']},
        setup_scopes_ms={str(list(path)):statistics.mean(sum(s['inclusive_ns'] for s in row['parent']['costs']['scopes'] if tuple(s['path'])==path) for row in group)/1e6 for path in sorted({tuple(s['path']) for row in group for s in row['parent']['costs']['scopes'] if s['path'][0]=='session_setup'})}) for key,group in groups.items()])


def package():
    archives=[];cohorts={};profiles=[];environments={}
    for kind in ('profile','diagnostic','confirmation'):
        directory=BASE/(kind+'-v1');manifest=load(directory/'manifest.json');validate_manifest(manifest)

        expected={'profile':64,'diagnostic':128,'confirmation':3072}[kind]

        for block in range(manifest['blocks']):
            block_dir=directory/f'block-{block:02d}';block_result=load(block_dir/'result.json');values={};logs={}
            for row in block_result['rows']:
                require(ref(ROOT/row['original_result']['path'])==row['original_result'],'changed original result')

                for record in row['records']:
                    binding=record['result'];require(ref(ROOT/binding['path'])==binding,'new result changed')
                    value=load(ROOT/binding['path']);matches(value,original,manifest['binary']);values[binding['path']]=value
                    require(record['certified']==(row['family']!='infinite-bound-refusal'),'certificate coverage')
                    if kind=='profile':
                        for assessment in value['delivery_profile']['assessments']:

                log=block_dir/(row['id']+'.stderr');logs[row['id']]=log.read_text()
            name=f'delivery4-{kind}-block-{block:02d}-evidence-v1.json.gz'
            archives.append(compressed(DATA/name,dict(kind=kind,block=block,started=load(block_dir/'STARTED.json'),result=block_result,outputs=values,stderr=logs)))
        environments[kind]=[dict(start=load(directory/f'block-{b:02d}'/'STARTED.json')['environment'],end=load(directory/f'block-{b:02d}'/'result.json')['environment']) for b in range(manifest['blocks'])]
        cohorts[kind]=dict(manifest=manifest,result=result,manifest_binding=ref(directory/'manifest.json'),result_binding=ref(directory/'result.json'))
    prior_sanitizers=load(DATA/'fp4-accel-acceptance-v2.json')

    require(set(prior_sanitizers['sanitizers'])=={'memcheck','racecheck','initcheck','synccheck'} and all(v['zero_errors'] and v['processes']==28 for v in prior_sanitizers['sanitizers'].values()),'sanitizer coverage')
    confirmation=cohorts['confirmation'];rows=confirmation['result']['rows'];families=list(confirmation['manifest']['models'])
    decisions=decisions_for(rows,families)
    medians=median_rows(rows);diagnostic_medians=median_rows(cohorts['diagnostic']['result']['rows'])
    lags=[]
    for lifecycle in ('cold',):
        for lane in LANES:
            for tier in TIERS:
                values=[]
                for block in range(32):
                    pair={r['role']:r for r in rows if r['block']==block and r['family']=='dense-generic-512' and r['lifecycle']==lifecycle and r['lane']==lane and r['tier']==tier}
                    values.append(pair['control']['complete_ns']/pair['candidate']['complete_ns'])
                lags.append(dict(lifecycle=lifecycle,lane=lane,tier=tier,lag_one_ratio_correlation=correlation(values),ratios=values))
    portable=compressed(DATA/'delivery4-cohorts-v1.json.gz',dict(cohorts=cohorts,
        model_bytes={f:(ROOT/b['path']).read_text() for f,b in confirmation['manifest']['models'].items()},
        selection=load(BASE/'selection-v1.json'),originals={path:load(ROOT/path) for path in sorted({c['original_result']['path'] for group in cohorts.values() for c in group['manifest']['cells']})},runner_source=(ROOT/'tools/lp_delivery4_cohort.py').read_text()))
    archive=BASE/'binaries'/ref(BINARY)['sha256'];archive.parent.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    if archive.exists():require(archive.read_bytes()==BINARY.read_bytes(),'binary archive differs')
    else:
        with archive.open('xb') as stream:stream.write(BINARY.read_bytes())
    ideal=[]
    for lane in LANES:
        for tier in TIERS:
            values=[r['records'][0] for r in rows if r['role']=='candidate' and r['lane']==lane and r['tier']==tier and r['family'] in ('dense-generic-128','dense-generic-256','dense-generic-512')]
            ratios=[v['complete_ns']/(v['complete_ns']-v['gpu_us']*1000) for v in values]
            ideal.append(dict(lane=lane,tier=tier,geometric_mean=math.exp(statistics.mean(math.log(v) for v in ratios)),n=len(values),assumption='Eliminate every GPU event interval with unchanged other work and no added cost; descriptive bound, not a forecast.'))
    value=dict(status='complete',report_source=ref(Path(__file__)),replay_source=ref(ROOT/'tools/lp_delivery4_replay.py'),candidate_ideal_gpu_removal=ideal,confirmation_cells=len(rows),confirmation_solves=sum(len(r['records']) for r in rows),
        confirmation_certificates=sum(record['certified'] for row in rows for record in row['records']),
        diagnostic_cells=192,diagnostic_solves=sum(len(row['records']) for kind in ('profile','diagnostic') for row in cohorts[kind]['result']['rows']),
        reused_sanitizers=dict(receipt=ref(DATA/'fp4-accel-acceptance-v2.json'),image=prior_sanitizers['admission']['image'],coverage=prior_sanitizers['sanitizers'],new_runs=0),candidate='candidate',selection=load(BASE/'selection-v1.json'),decisions=decisions,medians=medians,diagnostic_medians=diagnostic_medians,
        lag_one_descriptive=lags,environment=environments,profile_parent_requests=profiles,profile_lifecycle=lifecycle_profiles(cohorts['profile']['result']['rows']),
        startup={v:load(BASE/('startup-'+v+'-v2')/'result.json') for v in ('control','candidate')},
        startup_raw={name:dict(manifest=load(BASE/name/'manifest.json'),measurements={p.name:load(p) for p in sorted((BASE/name).glob('*.json')) if p.name not in ('manifest.json','result.json')}) for name in ('startup-v1','startup-control-v2','startup-candidate-v2')},dependencies=load(BASE/'dependencies-v2.json'),environment_binding=load(BASE/'environment-v1.json'),development_binaries=load(BASE/'development-binaries-v1.json'),
        archives=archives,cohorts_archive=portable,cpu=load(BASE/'cpu-v1/result.json'),device=ref(BASE/'device-v1/result.json'),binary_archive=ref(archive),
        exact_all_original_audits_certificates_checkpoints_and_work=True,
        inference_limit='Constructed development families on one shared device. Intervals assume independent comparable block effects; fresh processes and randomization do not prove independence. Lag correlations are descriptive, not an adjusted confidence analysis.')
    put(DATA/'delivery4-result-v1.json',value)
    for d in decisions:print(dict(lifecycle=d['lifecycle'],lane=d['lane'],tier=d['tier'],decision=d['decision'],benefit=d['benefit'],guards=[g for g in d['guards'] if g['decision']!='supported']),flush=True)

    require(result['diagnostic_solves']==192,'diagnostic count')
    for binding in [*result['archives'],result['cohorts_archive'],result['binary_archive'],result['device'],result['report_source'],result['replay_source']]:

            r=load(ROOT/s['resource']['path']);require(r['guardian_cleanup']['empty'] and r['result']['cleanup']['empty'],'cleanup incomplete')

    def tasks(text):
        points=list(re.finditer(r'^  - id: (\S+)\s*$',text,re.M));result={}
        for i,point in enumerate(points):
            require(point.group(1) not in result,'duplicate backlog identity')
            result[point.group(1)]=text[point.start():points[i+1].start() if i+1<len(points) else len(text)]
        return result
    old=tasks(subprocess.check_output(['git','show','eac5d00:state/backlog.yaml'],cwd=ROOT).decode())
